intent: The living room as the two shots see it, and the house's angle (Jade r3): the whole EAST wall is tall, a gable whose top rises from the 8-ft front corner to the 3.6 m ridge over the middle of the great room, the giant mirror hung high on it above the 7-ft grand; the floral couch against the front (south) wall under the large framed picture (1.4 x 1.0 m), the 1.5 m front window beside it throwing the low November-afternoon sun across her and onto the rug; the loveseat left of the rug, the armchair right. He stands back to camera handing her the folded hoodie. Not a shot.

hidden_by_fold.how: the lower body folded up over the front from his end: its ribbed waistband edge lies across the seal's lower part
